props.value: According to theTBSPolicy on Government Security andRCMPGCPSG-006 Access Management Guide, access to sensitive information and areas must be limited. A physical Operations Zone is the minimum required where sensitiveGCinformation is processed or stored. A TRA must be performed to ensure the appropriate level of physical security to protect Protected B information and information systems processing and storingPBdata. This zone is an area where access is limited to personnel who work there and to properly-escorted visitors by an employee with a valid reliability status; it must be indicated by a recognizable perimeter and monitored periodically.
